name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay has been adding a lot of $NBIS: ARR could reach ~$51B by 2029 vs a ~$45B market cap today, under 1x 2029 ARR, with ~50% adjusted EBITDA margins in core AI cloud and some deals paying back in under two years.
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay has been adding a lot of $NBIS: ARR could reach ~$51B by 2029 vs a ~$45B market cap today, under 1x 2029 ARR, with ~50% adjusted EBITDA margins in core AI cloud and some deals paying back in under two years.
text:
I've been adding a ton of $NBIS because its ARR could potentially reach ~$51B by 2029 while the entire company trades around a $45B market cap today.

That's less than 1x 2029 ARR for a business already reporting ~50% adjusted EBITDA margins in its core AI cloud operations with some capacity deals paying back in under two years.

And I think Token Factory could become an even bigger opportunity as production workloads more than tripled in Q2 with open model inference growing giving Nebius a way to earn more from every GPU rather than simply renting out the hardware.
